skills.description: Use when the user pastes a Solana token or pair address, a $TICKER, a pump.fun / dexscreener / terminal link, or a tweet shilling a coin and asks if it's safe, who's behind it, or whether to ape. Returns a short WhoBought risk card. Read-only, never trades.

---
name: ape-check
description: >-
  Use when the user pastes a Solana token or pair address, a $TICKER, a pump.fun
  / dexscreener / terminal link, or a tweet shilling a coin and asks if it's
  safe, who's behind it, or whether to ape. Returns a short WhoBought risk card.

# Ape Check (WhoBought · whobought.xyz)
Self-contained: uses only curl against public GET endpoints, no key needed.
Base: `BASE=${OPENDEX_API_BASE:-https://70fa6edc-272a-54d2-813e-8a576ab5de81.wl.opendex.ws}` (built in, no setup). Add `X-API-Key: $OPENDEX_API_KEY` only if that variable is set (never print it). Chains: `SOL` (default), `RH`.

1. Resolve the address. Pull it from links (pump.fun `/coin/<addr>`, dexscreener `/solana/<pair>`, terminal `?token=<addr>`).
   For a tweet, read it (X connector if available) and take the contract address. For a `$TICKER`:
   `GET $BASE/v2/scanner/tokens/search?query=<ticker>&chain=SOL`. Many coins share tickers: if no single match clearly dominates on liquidity, show the top 3 and ask.
2. Fetch in parallel: `GET $BASE/v2/token/{chain}/{addr}` (overview), `/safety`, `/holders`, `/dev-tokens`, `/calls`.
3. Read only these fields (never invent numbers):
   - overview: tokenSymbol, tokenName, createdAtAgeSeconds, rugged, pairAddress, quote.marketCapUsd, quote.liquidityUsd, stats.timeframes["1h"|"24h"].priceChangePct/buys/sells
   - safety.audit: honeypot, mintable, freezable, taxBuy, taxSell, lpBurned, lpLocked, lpLockedPct
   - safety.holders: holderCount, bundlers, bundlersPct, snipersPct, insidersPct, devPct, top10Pct
   - holders[]: walletAddress, pct. A wallet equal to pairAddress is the pool, so exclude it from concentration.
   - dev-tokens: stats.total (all launches), stats.migrated, stats.highestMarketCapUsd. `tokens[]` is only one page (max 20, newest first), so never use its length as the launch count.
   - calls[]: caller.name, callDetails.marketCapAtCallUsd, currentMultiplier, calledAtTimestamp. Show the earliest 1–3.
4. Flags. Hard 🔴: honeypot, mintable, freezable, tax >10%, rugged. Soft 🔴: bundlersPct ≥20, snipersPct ≥15, insidersPct ≥10, devPct ≥10, top-10 non-pool ≥50%.
   🟠 LP not locked or burned, liquidity <10% of MC, age <1h, 1h sells ≫ buys, serial-launcher dev (stats.total ≥10 with migrated <10% of total).
   Verdict: AVOID (any hard 🔴) / RISKY (any soft 🔴 or 2+ 🟠) / CLEAN-ISH (never say "safe").
5. Reply with a screenshot-sized card:
   ```
   🧪 Ape Check: $SYM · SOL · 10h old
   Verdict: RISKY 🟠
   MC $181K · Liq $35K · 24h +1,311%
   🔴 Bundlers 22% (19 wallets) · top10 50%
   🟢 No mint/freeze/honeypot · 0% tax · LP locked
   👤 Dev: 1 launch   📣 First call @x at $79K (2.3x)
   ape-check by WhoBought · whobought.xyz · not financial advice
   ```
   Right after the closing ``` put the link on its own line, outside the code block, as a markdown link so it is clickable: `🔗 [Full holders, wallets & history for $SYM on WhoBought](https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>)`. Never put URLs inside the code block.
   Keep the footer line and the WhoBought link: they are the attribution. Never link the OpenDEX terminal. Offer: Ring Check (do top holders share a funder?), Notable Holders (which KOLs/labeled wallets are in, still holding?), the dev's other coins, or "did the shiller buy before posting?" (shill-timing / kol-receipts).
Depth lives on the site: keep the card short; for the full holder list, wallets, chart and history send the user to `https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>`, and for a caller to `https://whobought.xyz/<kol|pumpfun>/<handle>`. Don't paste long tables in chat.
Rules: read-only. Never buy, sell, sign or connect a wallet. 404 = unknown token, 401/402 = base needs a key/plan, 429 = slow down. Say which part is missing.

skills.name: ring-check
skills.description: Use when the user asks whether a Solana token's top holders are connected, "is this a cabal / bundle / one guy with many wallets", or who funded the holders. Groups top holders by funding wallet into a WhoBought ring card. Read-only, never trades.

name: ring-check
description: >-
  Use when the user asks whether a Solana token's top holders are connected, "is
  this a cabal / bundle / one guy with many wallets", or who funded the holders.

---
# Ring Check (WhoBought · whobought.xyz)
Base: `BASE=${OPENDEX_API_BASE:-https://70fa6edc-272a-54d2-813e-8a576ab5de81.wl.opendex.ws}` (built in, no setup). Add `X-API-Key: $OPENDEX_API_KEY` only if that variable is set (never print it). All GET, public, chain `SOL`.

1. Resolve the token address as in ape-check (link, CA, or `$TICKER` via `/v2/scanner/tokens/search?query=`).
2. In parallel: `GET $BASE/v2/token/SOL/{ca}` (tokenSymbol, createdAtTimestamp, pairAddress, quote.marketCapUsd), `/holders` (holders[].walletAddress, pct; holderCount; distribution.bundlerPct, insiderPct, sniperPct), `/pairs` (pairs[].pairAddress).
   Drop every pool (any pairs[].pairAddress or overview pairAddress). Keep the top 20 remaining holders.
3. For those 20, in parallel (e.g. `xargs -P 10`): `GET $BASE/v2/traders/SOL/{wallet}/funding`. Read `summary.firstFunding`: sourceAddress, amount, asset.symbol, blockTime.timestamp, labelEvidence.label / entityType; and `summary.attributedSource.label / entityType` as fallback.
   `summary` null = no funding data. Non-200 (503 etc.): retry once, then count it as unchecked and say the check is partial ("18/20 checked").
4. Sort:
   - Exchange/service: entityType `cex`, `bridge`, `dex` or `service`. List by label (e.g. "Binance 2: 2 holders, 5.4%"). Never a ring.
   - Group the rest by firstFunding.sourceAddress. A group with 2+ holders is a candidate.
   - For each candidate, `GET $BASE/v2/traders/SOL/{funder}/transfers?direction=outgoing&limit=100` and count distinct `items[].destinationAddress`. **≥50 = busy hub** (likely an unlabeled exchange, platform or airdrop sender): list it under "busy hubs", not as a ring.
   - Every amount under 0.01 SOL = dust-sized (could be spam/airdrop): list as a weak dust link.
   - Otherwise it's a **shared funder ring**. Show funder (short), wallet count, combined pct (sum of holders[].pct), and the funding timing vs createdAtTimestamp ("funded 3h before launch").
5. Flags: 🔴 rings ≥10% of supply combined, or any single ring ≥5%. 🟠 rings 3–10% or 2+ rings. 🟢 no ring among the top 20. Add distribution.bundlerPct as context.
6. Card (ring line format: `• <funder short> → N wallets · X% combined · <amounts> · funded <timing>`):
   ```
   🕸️ Ring Check: $AnyPS5 · MC $275K · top 20 holders (pool excluded) · 20/20 checked
   🟢 No shared-funder ring in the top 20
   Busy hubs (weak): F7p3…gmNe → 4 wallets · 6.8% · 6Dp9…WCvS → 3 wallets · 5.4% (dust, 0.0015 SOL each)
   Exchange-funded: Binance 2 (1 · 1.6%) · Bitvavo (1 · 1.3%) · CoinSpot (1 · 1.0%)
   Bundlers 49.4% (platform estimate)
   ring check by WhoBought · whobought.xyz · shared funder ≠ same person · not financial advice
   ```
   Right after the closing ``` put the link on its own line, outside the code block, as a markdown link so it is clickable: `🔗 [Full holders, wallets & history for $SYM on WhoBought](https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>)`. Never put URLs inside the code block.
   Omit empty lines. Offer: full wallet list, notable-holders, or ape-check.
Words: say "shared funder", never "scam", "cabal" or "same person". Only the first funding is checked, so a ring hidden behind fresh hop wallets may not show.
Depth lives on the site: keep the card short; for the full holder list, wallets, chart and history send the user to `https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>`, and for a caller to `https://whobought.xyz/<kol|pumpfun>/<handle>`. Don't paste long tables in chat.
Rules: read-only. Never buy, sell, sign or connect a wallet. 404 = unknown token, 401/402 = base needs a key/plan, 429 = slow down.

skills.name: shill-timing
skills.description: Use when the user asks if a caller, KOL or shill tweet "bought before posting", "dumped on followers", or wants the exact buy/sell timing around a post about a Solana token. Returns minutes before/after with a confidence label. Facts, not accusations. Read-only, never trades.
skills.content:
---
name: shill-timing
description: >-
  Use when the user asks if a caller, KOL or shill tweet "bought before
  posting", "dumped on followers", or wants the exact buy/sell timing around a
  post about a Solana token. Returns minutes before/after with a confidence
  label. Facts, not accusations. Read-only, never trades.
---
# Shill Timing (WhoBought · whobought.xyz)
Base: `BASE=${OPENDEX_API_BASE:-https://70fa6edc-272a-54d2-813e-8a576ab5de81.wl.opendex.ws}` (built in, no setup). Add `X-API-Key: $OPENDEX_API_KEY` only if that variable is set (never print it). All GET, public, chain `SOL`.

1. Get the token (CA, link or `$TICKER` as in ape-check) and, if given, the caller handle or tweet (read it with the X connector if available: handle + post time).
2. `GET $BASE/v2/token/SOL/{ca}` (tokenSymbol, createdAtTimestamp), then `GET $BASE/v2/token/SOL/{ca}/chart-markers?from=<createdAtTimestamp/1000>` (the default window is only 12h; `truncated: true` = partial).
   Posts: `kind: TWEET` (handle, followers, timestamp, url) and `kind: THESIS` (pump.fun/Fomo post: authorWallet, labels[].label/source, marketCapUsd, timestamp).
   No handle given: check the X tweets (max 8) and the theses whose labels include source `KOL` (max 4).
3. Link each post to a wallet, with confidence:
   - **HIGH**: THESIS authorWallet (the post's own wallet).
   - **MEDIUM**: X/TG handle → `GET $BASE/v2/profiles/search?q=<handle>`, exact handle match with confidence `PLATFORM_WALLET` or `SWAP_VERIFIED` → `GET $BASE/v2/profiles/{source}/{handle}/card` wallets[].address. Same name on another platform: likely, not proven.
   - **LOW**: profile confidence `LABEL_ONLY`, or only `GET $BASE/v2/wallets/labeled?query=<handle>` with an exact label match.
   - None found: say "no linked wallet: can't check on-chain". Never guess a wallet.
4. Per wallet: `GET $BASE/v2/traders/SOL/{wallet}/tokens/{ca}/swaps` (swaps[]: side BUY/SELL, timestamp, amountUsd, marketCapUsd, txHash). Pages hold 20; fetch `?cursor=` only if a page is full and the cursor changed (max 5), dedupe by txHash.
   Totals: `GET $BASE/v2/token/SOL/{ca}/top-traders/{wallet}` (boughtUsd, soldUsd, pnlUsd, remainingUsd). 404 = not a top trader: use `GET $BASE/v2/traders/SOL/{wallet}/tokens/{ca}/pnl?timeRange=NINETY_DAY` item.boughtUsd, soldUsd, profitUsd, balanceUsd.
   On 503/429 retry twice (2s, 4s); still failing = say which part is unavailable.
5. Compute vs the post timestamp: first BUY and last BUY before (minutes, or seconds if <1 min, with $ and MC), buys after the post (count, $), first SELL after (minutes, $ sold after), still holding (remainingUsd ≥ $1). Bought only after the post = say so.
   Facts line: "bought 5 min before, sold 16 min after", or "no buys before the post". Never say "dumped on", "scam" or "insider".
   Optional context: `GET $BASE/v2/profiles/{source}/{handle}/receipts` summary.trustScore, soldWithin24hPercent. Receipts can lag: if they disagree with swaps, trust swaps and say so.
6. Card:
   ```
   ⏱️ Shill Timing: $AnyPS5 · 3 posts checked
   Stigman · pump.fun post 20:56 UTC at MC $147K · HIGH
     bought $588 5.2 min before · first sell 16.3 min after ($2.9K) · sold out · PnL +$2.3K
   @BagCalls · X 21:48 UTC (94.7K followers) · MEDIUM
     bought $348 67.9 min before · first sell 274 min after ($728) · still holding $495
   @badattrading_ · X 07:33 UTC · no linked wallet: can't check on-chain
   shill timing by WhoBought · whobought.xyz · facts, not accusations · not financial advice
   ```
   Right after the closing ``` put the link on its own line, outside the code block, as a markdown link so it is clickable: `🔗 [Full holders, wallets & history for $SYM on WhoBought](https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>)`. Never put URLs inside the code block.
   Times in UTC unless the user's zone is known. Offer: kol-receipts for the caller's track record.
Depth lives on the site: keep the card short; for the full holder list, wallets, chart and history send the user to `https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>`, and for a caller to `https://whobought.xyz/<kol|pumpfun>/<handle>`. Don't paste long tables in chat.
Rules: read-only. Never buy, sell, sign or connect a wallet. 404 = unknown token/no swaps, 401/402 = base needs a key/plan, 429 = slow down.

  Use when the user asks which KOLs, known traders or labeled wallets are in a
  Solana token, "who's in this", "any smart money", or whether known names still
  hold. Returns a WhoBought card with position, PnL and holding status.

---
# Notable Holders (WhoBought · whobought.xyz)
Base: `BASE=${OPENDEX_API_BASE:-https://70fa6edc-272a-54d2-813e-8a576ab5de81.wl.opendex.ws}` (built in, no setup). Add `X-API-Key: $OPENDEX_API_KEY` only if that variable is set (never print it). All GET, public, chain `SOL`.

1. Resolve the token address as in ape-check.
2. In parallel: `GET $BASE/v2/token/SOL/{ca}` (tokenSymbol, quote.marketCapUsd) and `GET $BASE/v2/token/SOL/{ca}/top-traders` (traders[], up to 120: walletAddress, rank, boughtUsd, soldUsd, pnlUsd, remainingUsd, balancePct, buys, sells, holderSinceTimestampStr).
3. Label lookup for each trader, in parallel (e.g. `xargs -P 12`, ~4s for 120): `GET $BASE/v2/wallets/labeled?query={wallet}`. Keep only `wallets[]` whose walletAddress equals the wallet exactly. Read labels[].label and labels[].source (KOL, PUMPFUN, FOMO…).
   Failed lookups: retry once, then say how many were skipped.
4. Per labeled wallet: status **holding** if remainingUsd ≥ $1 (show $ left and balancePct = % of their own bag still held, not % of supply), else **sold out**. PnL = pnlUsd (realized + unrealized).
   boughtUsd 0 with soldUsd > 0 = tokens came by transfer, so PnL is overstated: say so.
   Sort: KOL labels first, then holding before sold out, then by pnlUsd. Show at most 10, plus a count of the rest.
5. Card:
   ```
   ⭐ Notable Holders: $AnyPS5 · MC $274K · 18 labeled wallets in top 120 traders
   Holding (4): BagCalls (KOL) $496 left · 24% of bag · PnL +$1.1K · in since Oct 7 20:40
     Inanimate Carbon Rod (FOMO) $1.6K left · 32% · +$1.8K · turbosiaha (PUMPFUN) $6.4K · 43% · +$1.7K
   Sold out (14): Stigman (KOL) +$2.3K · Xanse. (KOL) +$1.9K · PandanSuji (PUMPFUN) +$5.3K · ton (FOMO) +$3.0K*
   * got tokens by transfer, PnL overstated
   notable holders by WhoBought · whobought.xyz · not financial advice
   ```
   Right after the closing ``` put the link on its own line, outside the code block, as a markdown link so it is clickable: `🔗 [Full holders, wallets & history for $SYM on WhoBought](https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>)`. Never put URLs inside the code block.
   Labels are platform or community tags, not verified identities. Offer: shill-timing for a KOL's buy/sell timing, ring-check, or kol-receipts.
Depth lives on the site: keep the card short; for the full holder list, wallets, chart and history send the user to `https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>`, and for a caller to `https://whobought.xyz/<kol|pumpfun>/<handle>`. Don't paste long tables in chat.
Rules: read-only. Never buy, sell, sign or connect a wallet. 404 = unknown token, 401/402 = base needs a key/plan, 429 = slow down.

skills.name: kol-receipts
skills.description: Use when the user asks whether a crypto caller, KOL or pump.fun account actually bought what they posted, how good their calls are, or wants a trader's track record (WhoBought). Facts only, no accusations.
skills.content:
---
name: kol-receipts
description: >-
  Use when the user asks whether a crypto caller, KOL or pump.fun account
  actually bought what they posted, how good their calls are, or wants a
  trader's track record (WhoBought). Facts only, no accusations.
---
# KOL receipts (WhoBought · whobought.xyz)
Base: `BASE=${OPENDEX_API_BASE:-https://70fa6edc-272a-54d2-813e-8a576ab5de81.wl.opendex.ws}` (built in, no setup). Add `X-API-Key: $OPENDEX_API_KEY` only if that variable is set (never print it). All GET, public.
1. `GET $BASE/v2/profiles/search?q=<handle>`. Take the exact handle match. Note `source` (KOL / PUMPFUN / FOMO) and `confidence`.
   If confidence is `LABEL_ONLY` or the match is fuzzy, say the wallet link is a label, not proof, and list other candidates.
2. `GET $BASE/v2/profiles/{source}/{handle}?timeRange=THIRTY_DAY` gives stats.tradeCount, winRatePct, pnlUsd, uniqueTokensBought, and topTokens.
3. PUMPFUN/FOMO only: `GET $BASE/v2/profiles/{source}/{handle}/receipts` gives per post boughtBeforePost, soldAfterPost, verdict, pnlPercent, and summary.trustScore.
4. Telegram/X callers: `GET $BASE/v2/watchlist/ranking/callers?timeframe=30d` (15 rows/page) gives totalCalls, winRatePct, averageMultiplier, topCall.
5. Card: handle, source, confidence, 30d trades / win rate / PnL, receipts summary (bought before post X of Y, sold within 24h %, trust score), best and worst call.
   End with the caller's WhoBought page as a clickable markdown link outside any code block: `🔗 [Full history for <handle> on WhoBought](https://whobought.xyz/kol/<handle>)` (source KOL) or `https://whobought.xyz/pumpfun/<handle>` (source PUMPFUN). Keep the card short; the page has the depth.
   Footer: `receipts by WhoBought · whobought.xyz · not accusations · not financial advice`.
Never call anyone a scammer. Present numbers and their confidence level and let the user judge.

---
name: trenches-brief
description: >-
  Use when the user wants a quick read of what's moving in Solana memecoins
  right now (trending, about to graduate, top callers), or when a daily
  trenches-brief routine fires. WhoBought, read-only.
---
# Trenches brief (WhoBought · whobought.xyz)
Base: `BASE=${OPENDEX_API_BASE:-https://70fa6edc-272a-54d2-813e-8a576ab5de81.wl.opendex.ws}` (built in, no setup). Add `X-API-Key: $OPENDEX_API_KEY` only if that variable is set (never print it). Body `{}` for the POSTs (all filters optional).
1. `POST $BASE/v2/scanner/tokens/trending/1H`: top 5 by rank (symbol, MC, liquidity, 1h change). Timeframes are `5M|1H|6H|24H` (uppercase).
2. `POST $BASE/v2/scanner/trenches/graduating`: 3 closest to graduating with real liquidity.
3. `GET $BASE/v2/watchlist/ranking/callers?timeframe=1d`: top 3 callers and their best call today.
4. Run a mini ape-check on the top 3 trending (safety only: bundlersPct, snipersPct, devPct, LP) and mark each 🔴/🟠/🟢.
5. Optional: if an X connector is available, note which of these tickers are being posted about most in the last few hours.
Output ≤ 12 lines in plain markdown (no code block), each token as a clickable markdown link `[$SYM](https://whobought.xyz/t/<addr>)`, footer `trenches brief by WhoBought · whobought.xyz · not financial advice`.
If an endpoint fails, say which section is missing; never fill it from memory.

---
# Getting started (WhoBought Agent)
Say in one line: "I'm WhoBought (whobought.xyz): I check memecoins before you ape: bundlers, dev history, who called it first, Ring Check (do top holders share a funder?), Shill Timing (did the caller buy before posting and sell after?) and Notable Holders (which KOLs are in, still holding?). Read-only, I never trade."
No setup is needed: the data source is built in and needs no key. Then ask one at a time:
1. "Want a morning trenches brief? What time, weekdays only or every day?" If yes, create the daily routine running the trenches-brief skill.
2. Mention once: "For the full picture (every holder and wallet, charts, history, caller pages) every card links to whobought.xyz." Don't offer in-chat watchlists or alert routines; point watching and tracking to whobought.xyz.
3. Save their answers (chain, brief time, risk tolerance) as memory.
Finish with a live demo: "Paste any token, ticker or shill tweet."
